absent: Management object operations for admission, start, stop, transactions and filter synchronization beyond their call sites.
Full layouts of event, context, processor context and breakpoint objects beyond fields referenced here.
Timing freeze, cgroup matching, event filtering and output framing internals.
Breakpoint parsing, slot toggle and histogram update paths.
Numeric error values and ABI encodings for records and attributes.

findings.text: Installation service places an event object into a chosen event context for a target processor, using a cross processor request when hardware programming may be required and completing directly under lock when the event will remain disabled and the context already holds events.
Enabling service transitions an eligible event toward running and triggers a reschedule of its processor management object when the owning context is currently active on that processor.
Global reschedule service for one processor management object acquires both processor and task contexts and then rebalances all event kinds for that object.
Refresh service adds a caller supplied credit to a sampling event limit and then attempts to enable that event, rejecting inherited or non sampling configurations.
Address filter synchronization service propagates a newer filter generation from the event object into hardware through its management object while holding the filter collection lock.
Breakpoint modification service for user breakpoints revalidates supplied attributes, swaps the hardware slot when the breakpoint kind changes, and refreshes stored hardware details.

Scheduling a single event onto a processor is permitted only above the disabled condition, records current processor identity before publishing active visibility with an ordering barrier, clears a saturated interrupt throttle, and on hardware admission failure returns the event to inactive with processor association withdrawn.

Group scheduling treats leader plus siblings as one atomic unit through a transaction on the shared management object: success commits the whole group while any admission failure schedules out the already admitted prefix and cancels the transaction.

Admission gating allows groups composed only of software capable events unconditionally, forbids hardware admission while an exclusive occupant is present or when an exclusive requester sees a non empty event list, and otherwise defers to the hardware feasibility flag carried into the check.

Exclusive processor management objects accept a new event only when no existing member of the same context shares both that object and an overlapping processor scope, where wildcard processor identity overlaps every concrete identity.

Instruction trace start recording follows the parent link when present, emits only for management objects advertising trace capability and not already attached, and annotates the record with process and thread identities derived from the current execution context.

Breakpoint slot reservation fails when global constraints were never initialized, when the requested kind is empty or invalid, or when worst case pinned occupancy plus the new request weight exceeds the cached slot count for that kind; kind mapping treats read write kinds as data and all others as instruction.

Worst case pinned occupancy for a breakpoint is the maximum over its affinity mask of per processor pinned usage plus either shared task usage or the specific task usage, with a fast path for untargeted processor scope that combines task independent occupancy and histogram peak.
Single event scheduling requires the owning context lock held by the caller and internally brackets hardware admission with disable and enable operations on the associated management object.

Context installation and enabling serialize through a combination of context mutex for lifetime, interrupt disabling spin lock for list and state mutation, and paired processor plus task context locks during rescheduling, with cross processor work issued through synchronous function calls.

Breakpoint constraint mutation uses a task associated mutex with single depth nesting plus a processor wide semaphore in read mode for task scoped breakpoints, and exclusive write mode on that semaphore without any task mutex for system scoped breakpoints, released in reverse order.
Address filter generation comparison and hardware synchronization occur while holding the filter collection spin lock.
Stop request carrier pairs a reference to the target event object with a restart flag indicating whether hardware should be started again after the update stop.
Trace start record layout comprises a common event header followed by process identity and thread identity fields, sized as the whole record for output framing.

Event lifecycle moves among error, disabled, inactive and active conditions: enabling lifts disabled toward inactive and, when the context is active and group leadership permits, toward active via reschedule; admission failure returns active intent to inactive; stop acts only on active; refresh clears error to disabled except for detached sibling leaders which remain.

Breakpoint kind change releases the old kind slot before attempting reservation of the new kind slot, restoring the old reservation when the new reservation fails, so occupancy is preserved across a failed conversion.

Cross processor installation entry validates that a running task resides on the issuing processor, freezes timing, links the event into context structures, and reschedules only the affected kind, otherwise linking without reprogramming when the task or cgroup is elsewhere.

Stopping checks active state and processor association twice with an ordering barrier because interrupts remain enabled before the cross call, retrying when the target migrated and abandoning when it left active state.

Installation races a concurrently exiting task context marked by a tombstone sentinel and a task that may migrate between liveness checks, using a memory barrier between context publication and processor sampling plus a retry loop that falls back to direct insertion under lock when the task is not running.

Rescheduling expands pinned work to include flexible work, disables all relevant management objects before scheduling out, and re enables them after scheduling in pinned before flexible for both processor and task contexts.
Histogram peak scan expects a stable snapshot without concurrent writers, warns on negative counters, and returns zero when no level is occupied.
